verdict.rationale: OpenAI's docs show project/service-account scoped API keys with configurable expiration and org-level policies restricting who can create keys (service-account only, disable creation, max lifetime), which supports least-privilege credential issuance for agents. However, there's no evidence of fine-grained per-tool/per-scope permission control (e.g., restricting a key to specific endpoints or capabilities) beyond project boundaries, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of this workflow. Missing for 10: granular scope/permission definitions per key, third-party verification of the expiration/service-account features in practice.
